question: A man observes the top of a building at an angle of elevation 45°. If the building is 20 m high, find the distance of the man from the building.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a right-angled triangle, if the angle of elevation is 45°, the perpendicular (height) and the base (distance) are always equal.

This is because tan(45°) = 1, which means Perpendicular = Base.

Since the height of the building is 20 m, the distance of the man from the building must also be 20 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 m.**
